$comment: Single source of truth for the Lambda function inventory.
scripts/bundle.ts reads this to produce artifacts/<name>.zip, and infra/ reads the
same file with jsondecode(file(...)) to declare the functions. Keeping one list means
a function cannot exist in Terraform without a bundle, or be bundled without being
deployed — the two cannot drift.
Fields:
name        Logical name. Becomes the zip filename and the Terraform map key.
entry       Path to the handler module, relative to backend/.
handler     Lambda handler string. The bundler emits index.js, so this is always
index.<exported symbol>.
vpc         true when the function needs database access, and therefore VPC
attachment plus the lambda security group.
timeout     Seconds.
memory      MB.
description Shown in the AWS console; keep it a single useful sentence.
db-migrate embeds backend/migrations/*.sql via esbuild's text loader, because
RDS lives in a private subnet with no public access: a laptop cannot reach it, so the
migration runner has to ship into the VPC with the SQL inside its own bundle.
There is deliberately no device-authorizer function. A REST API Lambda authorizer is
not given the request body, and the agent signature covers a hash of the body, so HMAC
verification runs inside each device handler via src/middleware/deviceAuth.ts.

functions.name: admin-api
functions.description: Administrative writes: employees, users, projects, config, devices, deletion requests.

functions.name: aggregate-timesheets
functions.description: Rolls raw activity events into per-employee daily timesheets. Scheduled and on-demand.

functions.name: db-migrate
functions.description: Applies forward-only migrations from inside the VPC; RDS is not publicly reachable so this is the only path in.

functions.name: device-config
functions.description: Serves the organisation's monitoring configuration and its version to the agent.

functions.name: enroll
functions.description: Consumes a single-use enrollment token and returns derived device credentials.

functions.name: heartbeat
functions.description: Records agent liveness, version, and health counters.

functions.name: ingest-events
functions.description: Idempotent batched activity-event ingestion with per-device quota enforcement.

functions.name: nonce-sweeper
functions.description: Expires replay-protection nonces older than the accepted request timestamp window.

functions.name: notice-ack
functions.description: Records the employee's acknowledgment of the first-run monitoring notice.

functions.name: pre-token-generation
functions.description: Injects org, role, employee, and MFA-status claims into Cognito access tokens.

functions.name: reporting-api
functions.description: Read APIs for the dashboard: overview, timesheets, activity, screenshot URLs, exports.

functions.name: retention-sweeper
functions.description: Deletes events, screenshots, and S3 objects past their configured retention window.

functions.name: screenshot-complete
functions.description: Marks a screenshot upload complete after the agent's direct S3 PUT succeeds.

functions.name: screenshot-presign
functions.description: Issues a constrained presigned S3 PUT for one screenshot upload.
